name: Universal Catalog
description: Entity-owned product and service definitions, variants, bundles, provenance and explicit external mappings. External catalogs remain provider-owned and read-only.

actions.label: Archive offering
actions.confirmation: Archive this offering? Historical references and accepted transactions remain retained.

fields.name: offeringTypes
fields.label: Applicable offering types (add at least one)

actions.label: Request exact original source read
actions.confirmation: Read this exact product or variant from its original connection, generation and installed provider? Discovery alone is not an exact import verification; changed or historical connections remain unavailable. Legacy v1 rows must use Developer Source Reads with their original source references instead of this action.

fields.name: mapping
fields.label: Original provider identity and field authority

actions.label: Request read-only source observation
actions.confirmation: Request a read-only observation from the approved original provider? This does not publish or change the external catalog.

actions.label: Apply reviewed import
actions.confirmation: Apply this explicit import plan? Review source identity, duplicates and mapping conflicts first. External provider records remain unchanged.

fields.name: query
fields.label: Provider name or SKU search (products or variants)

actions.label: Request governed external catalog read
actions.confirmation: Read cached provider-owned catalog facts from the approved installed provider? This does not synchronize or change the external catalog, create stock, accept a price or authorize production.

actions.label: Read next source page
actions.confirmation: Request the next bounded page from the original connection snapshot? A changed or unavailable snapshot requires explicit new discovery.

actions.label: Request governed reference discovery
actions.confirmation: Read metadata from the explicitly approved installed provider? This reserves no stock and creates no purchase or service obligation.

fields.name: proof
fields.label: Original provider and verified read evidence

actions.label: Verify original provider reference
actions.confirmation: Verify this exact original provider record through its approved binding? Only a valid constrained read receipt can activate this reference; no operational authority is granted.

actions.label: Deactivate reference
actions.confirmation: Deactivate this definition reference for new work? Existing order snapshots, reservations and obligations retain their original provider references.

externalCatalogMaxAgeSeconds.description: Maximum accepted age of cached external source facts. Provider expiry is never extended by this setting; historical observations grant no current price, stock or production authority.

operationalMaxAgeSeconds.description: Maximum age of operational reference metadata. A fresh reference grants no stock, supplier purchase, or service authority.

sourceMaxAgeHours.description: Maximum accepted age of a verified provider observation.

integrationsEnabled.description: Enable explicitly approved SSMA read-only interoperability. Local catalog operations remain available independently.
